mapper.insert: insert into litemall_event_outbox (aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, binding, payload, status, attempts, created_at, sent_at) values (#{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{eventType}, #{binding}, #{payload}, #{status}, #{attempts}, #{createdAt}, #{sentAt})
mapper.select: select id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, binding, payload, status, attempts, created_at, sent_at from litemall_event_outbox where status = 'PENDING' order by id asc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update litemall_event_outbox set attempts = attempts + 1, status = case when attempts + 1 >= #{maxAttempts} then 'FAILED' else 'PENDING' end where id = #{id}
